units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take on contact sheets and close-ups. Idle v1 every second frame (one rejected plate); move v1 one stomping cycle that loops on the guide pose; attack v1 draws the fist back, lunges to full reach and recovers; hit v1 starts on the painted hit pose and recovers; defend v2, cast v2 and death v2 replace v1 takes whose transitions were lost to rejected plates or smeared through a snap: a gradual brace behind the kite shield, a slow raised-palm command and lowering, and a kneel that sinks forward to a face-down corpse with the shield at screen right.
